remarks: Welcome to the Stone Gate complex in West Norwalk. This 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence has 1,288 sq ft of living space. Nestled in the heart of convenience, you're minutes away from everyday necessities, incl highways, parks, schools, shopping centers, & an array of top-notch restaurants. For those with a love for sports, a public golf course & har-tru tennis courts are minutes away. The complex is managed with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring a serene living environment for all residents. It boasts ample guest parking, well-lit surroundings, & is beautified with mature plantings & trees that creates a soothing ambiance. The open plan living & dining room on the main level exudes elegance with a cozy wood-burning fpl & polished hardwood flrs. Sliding doors open onto a secluded patio at the rear, the perfect retreat for relaxation. The front of the unit has the updated kit w/corian countertops, under-cabinet lighting, & plenty of room for a dining set. A half bath completes this area. The upper level has two generously proportioned bedrooms, each with large closets, & 2 full baths. The primary bedroom treats you to the luxury of an en-suite bathroom. The ent lev features a 1 car gar, laundry room, & additional space that can accommodate exercise equip or storage. Central air & various other amenities enhance the comfort of this fantastic unit. Given its prime location & proximity to essential amenities, we recommend you to schedule your visit as soon as possible.
